title: 812. Binary Tree Pruning

examples.explanation: The left-zero leaf with no 1 below it is removed, while the right branch survives because it holds a 1.
Zero-only subtrees on the left vanish; branches containing a 1 are kept.
No 1 appears anywhere, so the whole tree is pruned away.
